newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony to make PCs in US, end OEM with Intel - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sony to make PCs in US, end OEM with Intel - paper.

text.p: Sony Corp has decided to produce personal computers at its San Diego factory in the United States and to end an original equipment manufacturing deal with Intel Corp, the business daily Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun reported on Friday.
Intel has been making Sony's desktop PCs, which were launched in the U.S. market in September 1996.
The paper said Sony would build facilities with a production capacity of several tens of thousands of PCs per month at the San Diego factory. Operations will begin this autumn, the paper said.
Sony plans to introduce notebook-sized PCs in July in the U.S. and Japan, it said.
The notebook PCs will initially be made in Japan, but the company plans eventually to move production to the San Diego factory, the paper said.
A Sony spokesman said he could not immediately confirm the report.
